name: Summon Dragon
summary: Calls a Draconic Spirit ally whose defenses, attacks, and breath scale with the spell's level.

m.text: an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP

stats.effect:
You call forth a Dragon spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Draconic Spirit stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your {ref:glossary/initiative} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {ref:glossary/dodge} action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
stats.higherLevels: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

statBlocks.name: Draconic Spirit
statBlocks.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 12
statBlocks.languages: Draconic, understands the languages you know
statBlocks.cr: None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

traits.name: Shared Resistances
traits.text: When you summon the spirit, choose one of its Resistances. You have {ref:glossary/resistance} to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down), and it uses Breath Weapon.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 feet. *Hit:* 1d6 + 4 + the spell's level Piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot {ref:glossary/cone}. *Failure:* 2d6 damage of a type this spirit has {ref:glossary/resistance} to (your choice when you cast the spell). *Success:* Half damage.
